intent.summary: Modern, calm qPCR/primer analysis console with compact operational density, quiet surfaces, teal action focus, and table-first navigation.
avoid: bulky spacing that reduces result density

layout: Preserve two-pane lab workbench: setup rail left, result workspace right.
Keep melting temperatures first, then flagged structures, matrix, and detailed structures.
Use semantic severity color tags in tables and matrix cells.
Keep controls compact; prefer 8 px default gaps and 12 px pane gutters.
